trace.tail: at the station stare at us as if we are mad. But we carry on, running up and down, screaming profanities, and let the rest of the world GO FUCK ITSELF! . . .
s. There is a sink in one corner and an old wardrobe in another. The doorway leads east. A solitary window allows a cold light into the room. Wayne and Paddy are lying asleep in their bunkbeds. >
